newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Physical gold market in equilibrium - Anglo.
newsitem.headline: Physical gold market in equilibrium - Anglo.

text.p: The physical gold market has reached a state of equilibrium around current price levels, Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd marketing director Kelvin Williams said on Thursday.
Speaking at a presentation of the group's third quarter gold results, Williams said:

"While speculators or short-term investors might be able to bring about a rally in the paper gold market from time to time, it would seem that the physical gold market has reached some kind of equilibrium around the current price range."
Although saying that the gold price may have reached the bottom of its weakest state, Williams added:
"While the gold market has not broken down below the lower end of the price range, sentiment regarding this market is not at all positive.
"Gold price weakness in the past has been linked by commentators to incremental supply onto the market by gold forward producer hedging."
